about: The MCP servers the compatibility run cages (test/compat/run.mjs): those started with npx, in the order of their npm downloads, then those started with uvx, in the order of their PyPI downloads over 30 days. How they were chosen, and what each result means, is in docs/compatibility.md. Fields: runner (npx or uvx, default npx), package (as its README writes it), npx (npx's flags, default -y), uvx (uvx's flags before the package, default none), command (the package's program, when its name is not the package's: started as uvx --from <package> <command>), args ({dir} is a fresh folder with one file, hello.txt), windows (the whole line, run instead on Windows, where the README writes another one for Windows), mounts, files (more files for that folder), env (given with --env: dummy keys for servers that refuse to start without one, or a setting), call (one harmless tool call; expect is text its answer must hold, {base} the folder's name), expected (ok, needs network, fails, build fails), notes.

servers.name: playwright
servers.notes: Lists its tools. Its browser tools need a browser, which the cage does not have: install scripts are off, and nothing is downloaded when it runs.

servers.name: pdf
servers.notes: Started as its README writes it, with npx --silent.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.notes: Lists its tools. It drives an installed Google Chrome, which the cage does not have.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.notes: The folder is mounted read-only. On Windows the server sees it at /c/Users/...

servers.name: mcp-remote
servers.notes: A bridge to a remote server, here DeepWiki's, which needs no key. It connects when it starts, so it needs --allow-net.

servers.name: context7
servers.notes: Lists its tools without the network; its calls fetch documentation and need --allow-net.

servers.name: desktop-commander
servers.notes: Lists its tools. Its commands need a shell, and the cage's image has none.

servers.name: notion
servers.notes: Starts without a token.

servers.name: memory
servers.notes: Keeps its graph next to its code, which is read-only in the cage: to write, set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to a file in a :rw mount.

servers.name: hostinger
servers.notes: Starts without a token.

servers.name: sentry
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: gitlab
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: pandacss
servers.notes: Reads the Panda project of its working directory, which in the cage is the image's /app: it is given --cwd and the project's folder.

servers.name: supabase
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a token, so it is given a dummy one, and fetches from Supabase's API to answer tools/list.

servers.name: github
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Starts without a token.

servers.name: mongodb
servers.notes: Starts without a connection string.

servers.name: slack
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Refuses to start without a token and a team id, so it is given dummy ones.

servers.name: azure
servers.notes: A .NET program that needs ICU, which the cage's image does not have: DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 lets it run without.

servers.name: figma
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a key, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: postgres
servers.notes: Archived reference server. Starts with a database it cannot reach, and connects only to answer a query.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.notes: Starts without a key.

servers.name: mcp-for-blender
servers.notes: Lists its tools, which drive Blender through its add-on on the host, out of the cage's reach.

servers.name: aws-proxy
servers.notes: A SigV4 proxy to the AWS endpoint its README shows: it refuses to start without AWS credentials, so it is given dummy ones, and connects when it starts, so it needs --allow-net.

servers.name: fetch
servers.notes: Lists its tools without the network; fetching a page needs --allow-net.

servers.name: atlassian
servers.notes: Lists no tools without a Jira or Confluence site, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: postgres-mcp
servers.notes: Started as plain uvx, as its README starts it with uv run or pipx; 0.3.0 needs pglast 7.2.0, which PyPI does not have.

servers.name: lean-lsp
servers.notes: Lists its tools, which need Lean, which the cage does not have.

servers.name: grafana
servers.notes: Starts without a Grafana URL or token.

servers.name: aws-api
servers.notes: Fetches from servicereference.us-east-1.amazonaws.com when it starts, so it needs --allow-net.

servers.name: git
servers.notes: GIT_PYTHON_REFRESH=quiet lets it start without git, which its tools need and the cage does not have; started without --repository, with which it stops on a folder that is not a Git repository.

servers.name: opensearch
servers.notes: Starts without a cluster: its tools take the cluster's URL on each call.

servers.name: aws-documentation
servers.notes: Lists its tools without the network; they fetch AWS's documentation and need --allow-net.

servers.name: unity
servers.notes: Started with uvx --from, as its README writes it; its tools need the Unity Editor and its plugin on the host.

servers.name: workspace
servers.notes: Starts without Google OAuth credentials.

servers.name: chroma
servers.notes: Stops on an ImportError from pydantic (eval_type_backport), as it does with uvx outside the cage.

servers.name: clickhouse
servers.notes: Started as plain uvx, as its README starts it with uv run --with and --python 3.12; it starts without a ClickHouse server.

servers.name: blender-mcp
servers.notes: The old name of mcp-for-blender, which it depends on and starts.

servers.name: excel
servers.notes: Given the folder it may use with --allow-dir, mounted read-only.

servers.name: langsmith
servers.notes: Starts without a LangSmith key.

servers.name: aws-cloudwatch
servers.notes: Starts without AWS credentials.

servers.name: serena
servers.notes: Started as uvx --from with its serena program, as its README installs it with uv tool install -p 3.13; a dependency, proxy-tools, has no wheel.

servers.name: aws-pricing
servers.notes: Starts without AWS credentials.

servers.name: pagerduty
servers.notes: Refuses to start without a key, so it is given a dummy one.

servers.name: analytics
servers.notes: Started as uvx, as its README starts it with pipx run; it starts without Google credentials.

servers.name: dbt
servers.notes: A dependency, uuid 1.30, has no wheel on PyPI.

servers.name: google-sheets
servers.notes: Stops at start: it imports mcp.server.fastmcp, which mcp 2.x removed, as it does with uvx outside the cage.

servers.name: duckduckgo
servers.notes: Started with --with duckduckgo-mcp-server[browser], as its README writes it for its browser backends, all from wheels.

servers.name: arxiv
servers.notes: Started with --python 3.11, as its README says to when a client keeps an older environment.
